source_audits.native_binary_and_full_regression: Every tracked file SHA-256 matched 992b07b5d before build, no extra .rs/.py/.toml sources. Dedicated debug and release-validation targets.
source_audits.oracle_tools: Every tracked tools/simulation file matched ee3815ad7.
source_audits.reviewed_revision: Every tracked file matches 68f863c1d; eight parameter-history TOMLs generated by own MS tests were removed before the final extra-source audit.

upstream_read.focus: MCEpoch::UT1_GAST and NewMSSimulator::calcAntUVW. Reuse the existing casacore_sidereal helper rather than duplicate sidereal formulas.

baseline.stored_times: Identical on both sides in the five probed task cases.
baseline.sidereal_test_before: Fails on original a9662f5e0 helper; five-case maximum LAST residual 1.320436116e-8 rad.

commands.full_regression: RUST_TEST_THREADS=1 cargo test --locked -p casa-types -p casa-ms -p casa-simulation -- --nocapture
commands.lint: cargo clippy --locked -p casa-types -p casa-ms -p casa-simulation --all-targets -- -D warnings
commands.parity: CASAPY tools/simulation/simobserve_parity.py --out OUT --casars-bin TARGET/release-validation/release/simobserve --casatestdata PUBLIC_LOCAL_COPY --uvw-tolerance-m 1e-6 --only model_direction model_cell model_direction_cell components_cube frame_topo coarse_cell schedule_hour_number schedule_hour_quantity schedule_refdate_modern schedule_square frame_lsrd frame_geo frame_galacto frame_lgroup frame_cmb pointing_file_multiple pointing_explicit_spacing

validation.ignored_scope: Four optional plot/large-disk diagnostics and five documented parent-executed counting/holding/PSF helpers. C++ MS reads are separately executed by the full paired task comparator.
validation.reviewed_test_and_clippy: Passed: exact complete source audit, all-target casa-types Clippy including the benchmark, and the final count/finite-checked independent sidereal test.

review.kind: One fresh-context Astra xhigh static local review, required by AGENTS.md Review level 2 for the shared helper

decisions: Reuse casacore_sidereal::gast_rad, preserving the high-precision UT1 epoch and adding observatory longitude once.

Use the existing maintained serde_json crate as a direct test-only dependency for the independent JSON fixture (MIT OR Apache-2.0); already present transitively through Criterion. No new runtime dependency.
Keep the comparator default at its historical allowance; explicitly select the stricter 1e-6 m goal for this complete 17-scenario replay.
limits: This proves the one-micrometre UVW goal on these sixteen successful task scenarios, not all remaining simulation modes or all long baselines.
Whole-task performance, remaining calculation modes and complete #1053 acceptance stay open.
Plotting remains paused under the owner priority; this change contains no plotting implementation.
